cells.value: Every structural change. One line each. This is the handover document when the system moves to Claude Code or the ERP.
Replaced the static return manager.xlsx with a formula-driven system: raw paste zones, one transform layer, role-scoped views.
Free text produced 46% unusable records and 23 dates typed into a text field.
'dead customer' conflated 'could not reach' with 'no reason given'. Different problems, different fixes.
v2.0 - rebuilt on the live Bosta export
RAW_Bosta is now column-for-column identical to the Bosta download. No mapping step, nothing to get wrong on paste.
RTO, CUSTOMER_RETURN_PICKUP and EXCHANGE_return were being counted as one thing. 15 post-delivery returns and 10 exchange legs were invisible in v1.
v1 divided by a hardcoded guess of 149 orders. The real outbound count is now read from the export.
Line items parsed from the Description field
Bosta carries the product string. Parsing it removed the need for a separate store export and made product and size analysis self-updating.
One row per variant with price and cost. Replaces the AOV proxy once filled.
Bosta zeroes COD on returns and carries no fee column, so courier cost has to come from the wallet export.
AOV computed live instead of assumed
v1 used a manual AOV cell. It is now the measured mean of delivered COD orders, and every figure derived from it is tagged VALUE-IS-PROXY.
Config s2 rate card and s3 scenario modifiers marked OUT OF USE
All 237 shipments price from the Bosta wallet (fee_source = Bosta wallet, 237/237). Fallback never hit; filling it would create a silent-error path. Retained as ERP-migration shell.
